GREY WORM LEADER OF THE UNSULLIED

Who Grey Worm was trained to be:

The Unsullied are cut as boys, not just physically, but emotionally. They are given a new name every day to make them forget who they were. They are taught to feel no pain, no fear, no love, no anger. When Kraznys orders one to cut off his own nipple to prove loyalty, he does it without flinching. That was Grey Worm's entire life. An emotionless weapon.

Daenerys frees him, but freedom doesn't teach you how to feel. He still talks like a soldier. "Many masters. Many faces. The slave who freed slaves." Short, clipped, no emotion.

*What Missandei did:*

Missandei didn't try to fix him. She just treated him like a man, not a soldier.

She taught him Common Tongue. She sat with him when he was stabbed by the Sons of the Harpy. She kissed him first, because she knew he would never think he deserved to make the first move.

Slowly you see him change. He starts using "I" instead of "this one". He learns jealousy when he sees Missandei with other people. He learns fear when she is in danger at Casterly Rock. He learns desire, he learns tenderness.

For the first time since he was 5 years old, Grey Worm had something that was HIS. Not Daenerys', not the army's. His. A future where he and Missandei go to Naath and live in peace.

*Then they behead her on the wall of King's Landing.*

Cersei does it specifically to hurt Daenerys, but she actually creates two monsters. 

Missandei's last word is "Dracarys" meaning "burn them all." And Grey Worm hears it.

At King's Landing, the bells ring. The Lannister army surrenders. By all rules of war, it's over.

Then Daenerys burns the city anyway.

And Grey Worm is the first to break rank. He throws his spear straight through an unarmed Lannister soldier's chest. And then he looks at his Unsullied and they all start slaughtering.

People call it a war crime and it is. But emotionally?

That wasn't Commander Grey Worm of the Unsullied breaking discipline. That was just Grey — a man who learned to love for the first time in his life, and watched that love get her head cut off while chained.

The Masters trained him to have no emotions so he could never seek revenge.

Missandei taught him to have emotions, so revenge was the only thing left.

That's why his story is so heartbreaking. He started as an emotionless man with no heartbreak. She gave him a heart. And then they broke it.

He levvies an accusation against young adult men, that they're pussies, and gives evidence that because of it he doesn't have to worry about them doing *unspecified things* with/to his underage daughter.
The implication is that if you weren't a pussy, you'd be doing those *unspecified things* to daughter.

Obviously these *unspecified things* are sexual, but innuendo leaves plausible deniability intentionally. Innuendo always includes deniability. He feigns ignorance in the replies by saying you are sickos for interpreting his words in a sexual way, but by his own words he's specifically talking about things he would "be worried about". Mind you this might just be emotional rather than physical incest, but this *at best* an extremely unhealthy relationship between father and daughter.

That's the reason your disgust radar is going off. It's not just because he's insulting any potential partner she might eventually find. It's because he's a verifiable sick fuck.
